title: Generic stack
hints: Inside every method, `T` is the element type this stack was created with, so `s.items` is a `[]T`. For "nothing to return" you need a `T` value: `var zero T` gives you its zero value (`0`, `""`, `nil`, …).
`Push`: `s.items = append(s.items, v)`. `Peek`: if `len(s.items) == 0` return `zero, false`, else return the last element. `Pop`: reuse `Peek`, then shrink with `s.items = s.items[:len(s.items)-1]`.
`Drain` only knows the interface: `out := make([]T, 0, c.Len())`, then `for { v, ok := c.Pop(); if !ok { return out }; out = append(out, v) }`.
